```{python}
#| include: false
import itables
import plotly.graph_objects as go

from read_data import (
    growth_summary,
    load_internal_stats,
    load_omraade_stats,
    load_rolle_stats,
    prepare_stats,
)

data = prepare_stats(load_rolle_stats())
summary = growth_summary(data)
internal = load_internal_stats()
omraade_data = prepare_stats(load_omraade_stats(), group_column="Område")
omraade_summary = growth_summary(omraade_data, group_column="Område")
```

# Oversikt {scrolling=true}

## Row

```{python}
#| title: Folk i teamkatalogen over tid
figure = go.Figure(
  data=[
    go.Bar(
      x=internal["dato_mnd"],
      y=internal["antall_totalt"],
      name="Antall totalt",
      marker_color="#5c6281",
      hovertemplate="%{x|%Y-%m}<br>Antall totalt: %{y:,.0f}<extra></extra>",
    ),
    go.Scatter(
      x=internal["dato_mnd"],
      y=internal["andel_interne"],
      name="Andel interne (%)",
      mode="lines+markers",
      line={"color": "#d94801", "width": 4},
      marker={"size": 7, "line": {"color": "white", "width": 1}},
      yaxis="y2",
      hovertemplate="%{x|%Y-%m}<br>Andel interne: %{y:.1f} %<extra></extra>",
    ),
  ],
  layout=go.Layout(
    template="plotly_white",
    xaxis={"title": "Måned", "type": "date"},
    yaxis={"title": "Antall personer", "rangemode": "tozero"},
    yaxis2={
      "title": "Andel interne (%)",
      "overlaying": "y",
      "side": "right",
      "range": [70, 100],
      "ticksuffix": " %",
      "showgrid": False,
    },
    legend={"orientation": "h", "y": 1.15},
  ),
)
figure.show()
```
